privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: Krishyak collects only the information needed to provide farm estimates, weather, scheme checks, and crop-health tools.

1.title: Information we use
1.body: Registration details, farm inputs, optional location, and crop photos are used only for the feature you choose.

2.title: Location and photos
2.body: Location and crop photos are optional. Voice recordings and text selected for read-aloud are sent to Sarvam for speech processing. Manual text input remains available.

3.title: Aadhaar and sharing
3.body: Aadhaar is optional. The full Aadhaar number is never stored. Krishyak does not sell personal information.

4.title: Control your data
4.body: You can skip registration, clear local data by logging out, and request deletion of server records.

privacy.contact: Privacy questions or deletion requests: privacy@krishyak.app

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.summary: Krishyak is a decision-support tool. It does not replace an agriculture officer, laboratory test, bank, insurer, or government portal.

1.title: Use accurate farm details
1.body: Enter correct crop, soil, area, and cost information. Better inputs produce more useful estimates.

2.title: Estimates are not guarantees
2.body: Yield, profit, risk, weather, disease, and price results can differ from real field conditions.

3.title: Government schemes
3.body: Scheme eligibility and benefit amounts must be confirmed on the official government portal or with an authorized officer.

4.title: Safe farming decisions
4.body: Check chemical treatment, irrigation, credit, and selling decisions with a qualified local expert.

landing.eyebrow: Rooted in the field. Guided by insight.
landing.title: Every season.
landing.intro: Your hard work deserves a well-informed plan. Understand crop health, compare farming choices, and see what your next harvest could look like - all in one place.
landing.builtFor: For the people who know their land best.
landing.photoAlt: A farmer carrying young rice plants through a flooded paddy field in India
landing.fieldNote: A little clarity goes a long way
landing.fieldNoteCopy: Bring your experience. Let the numbers help.
landing.toolsEyebrow: From the first seed to the next sale
landing.toolsTitle: A clearer picture of your farm.
landing.toolsCopy: Useful information, brought together. Explore every estimate and comparison at your own pace.
landing.planTitle: Make a plan that adds up.
landing.planCopy: Explore estimated yield, cultivation costs, revenue, profit and return on investment using your own farm inputs.
landing.healthTitle: Give your crops a closer look.
landing.healthCopy: Upload a leaf photo to check for supported crop diseases. Review confidence, uncertainty and the available guidance.
landing.marketTitle: Know the market before you sell.
landing.marketCopy: Check mandi prices, minimum support prices and price forecasts to help you think through when to sell.
landing.weatherTitle: Be ready for what may change.
landing.weatherCopy: Review weather alerts, pest information and risk estimates. Compare scenarios and explore alternative farm plans.
landing.howTitle: A few details. A more informed decision.
landing.howCopy: Start with what you know about your farm. Krishyak helps you see the possibilities.
landing.stepOneCopy: Register with your farm details, or explore as a guest. Choose your language and enter your crop, soil and land area.
landing.stepTwoCopy: Add your costs and farming inputs. Run the simulation to see estimated outcomes, risks and possible alternatives.
landing.stepThreeCopy: Review the detailed analysis, change your inputs and compare again. You remain in charge of every farming decision.
landing.languageCopy: Read the interface in your own language. Use voice input or type your details. Read-aloud is available in 11 supported languages.
landing.ctaTitle: Put a little more insight into every acre.
landing.ctaCopy: Bring your farm details. Explore the possibilities. Make the next decision with a clearer view.
landing.faqOneTitle: Do I need to register to explore?
landing.faqOneCopy: You can explore as a guest. Registration adds your farm profile to the existing workflow. You can review and edit the farm inputs before running a simulation.
landing.faqTwoCopy: No. Yield, cost, profit, price and risk results are estimates based on your inputs and the available data. Actual field outcomes can differ. Use local expertise alongside the analysis.
landing.faqThreeTitle: Can I use it on my phone?
landing.faqThreeCopy: Yes. Open farm inputs from the mobile controls and use the tabs to reach every analysis. Voice input requires microphone permission and an internet connection; typed input is also available.
landing.workspaceCopy: Explore the details. Compare your choices. Plan your next step.
